post.description: This endpoint saves cluster lock objects that describe the created Distributed Validator Cluster. The lock is stored with its own cluster_definition (the one covered by lock_hash), which is what lock reads return. If the lock_hash is already stored with its definition, the existing lock is returned (idempotent; no re-validation) with the same 201 response. If it is stored without one (saved by an earlier API version, `definition_stored: false`), the posted file is validated and its definition stored. The posted `cluster_definition.config_hash` must be the hash of the posted definition, and when a definition record exists for it the lock must have the same operator and creator addresses and configuration (400 otherwise). Several locks can share a config_hash (the DKG run again, or the same validator keys re-split to other nodes): each is stored. For definitions whose operators do not sign their ENRs (solo flow, `charon create cluster`), a further lock must re-split the validator keys of a stored lock (409 otherwise). `GET /lock/configHash/{configHash}` returns the most recently created of them. The current lock for a config_hash and its validators (`is_current`, `superseded_by`, positions and counts) is the one whose Charon nodes reported most recently, else the most recently created. The cluster definition record (GET /definition/{configHash}) is never changed by this endpoint.

400.description: Invalid lock data, a config_hash that does not match the posted definition, or a definition that does not match the stored definition record for its config_hash

404.description: The cluster definition corresponding to this lock file was not found

409.description: The lock file does not match the stored lock with this lock_hash; or, for a definition whose operators do not sign their ENRs, a lock with other validator keys is already stored; or another lock for this config_hash is stored and the API cannot store a second one yet (retry later).

This endpoint saves partial signed exit messages. Every `partial_exits[].public_key` must be a `distributed_public_key` of the lock (matched case-insensitively). `epoch` and `validator_index` are uint64 decimal strings.

The API keeps exactly one exit per validator pubkey: the first accepted partial exit fixes its `epoch` and `validator_index`, and later partial exits for that pubkey from any operator must use the same values or are rejected with 400. To change the epoch, every operator must first delete their partial exit. A pubkey whose exit is stored under a different lock hash is rejected with 409.

post.description: What our beacon node's head state holds for each pubkey: the validator registry entry (status, balances, activation and exit epochs), every deposit in the pending deposit queue (EIP-6110), each with its own withdrawal credentials, and the total queued in the pending partial withdrawal queue (EIP-7002). Returns one entry per distinct requested pubkey, in request order, including pubkeys with status `new`. Accepts up to 1000 pubkeys per request (96 hex characters, 0x prefix optional, case-insensitive). Amounts are wei decimal strings. Queued deposit signatures are verified in the background, each queue entry once; a queue-only pubkey whose deposits are not all verified yet has `signaturesPending: true` (retry for the complete answer). Any upstream failure fails the whole request so a partial answer can never read as `new`. Entries are cached per pubkey for one slot.

get.description: Provenance (CreateObolValidatorManager from the network OVM factory), state (one Multicall3 read), role holders (RolesUpdated candidates, rolesOf at the same block), the 0xSplits v2 params of its recipients (verified against splitHash) and the validators whose credentials point at it. Every chain read is made at `blockNumber`. Amounts are wei decimal strings; addresses checksummed. Validators come from the goteth registry snapshot in ClickHouse (daily), the beacon registry past it and the pending deposit queue, with current status from the head state. Roles, splits and validators are only read for a verified Obol OVM (provenance `obol`); for any other contract they are null and only provenance and state are returned. Sections that could not be read are null and explained in `notes`. An address without code is 200 with provenance `notObol`. Complete answers, and answers for `notObol` addresses, are cached for one slot; answers with a section that could not be read are not cached.

info.title: Obol API
info.description:
## What is this API?

This API is for creating and managing [Distributed Validators](https://docs.obol.org/learn/intro/key-concepts). It works in tandem with Obol's [Distributed Validator Launchpad](https://launchpad.obol.org), a dapp for authenticating counterparties and agreeing on the terms of a Distributed Validator Cluster. For code-only use, the [Obol SDK](https://docs.obol.org/sdk) wraps it with types. Endpoints are listed under `/v1`; older clients may still call most of them without the prefix.

## Errors, request ids and rate limits

- Every error has a JSON body: `{ "statusCode": 404, "message": "Cluster not found" }`. Validation errors carry a list of messages and an `error` reason. A 500 always says `Internal server error`.
- Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header (Cloudflare's Ray ID for requests through Cloudflare). Quote it when reporting a problem.
- Busy public reads may be rate limited per IP: a 429 carries `Retry-After` in seconds.
- See [Errors and rate limits](https://docs.obol.org/api/errors-and-rate-limits) for details.

Read more about Obol and the [launchpad](https://docs.obol.org/learn/intro/launchpad) on our [docs site](https://docs.obol.org).

For enquiries:

definition_stored.description: true: cluster_definition is the exact definition this lock was created with (covered by lock_hash). false: this lock was stored without its exact cluster definition; lock_hash cannot be re-verified until the lock file is posted again.

is_current.description: true: this is the current lock for its validators and config_hash. Several locks can share validator keys or a config_hash (re-split or DKG re-run); the current one is the lock whose Charon nodes reported most recently to Obol monitoring, or, when none of them has reported, the most recently created. It can change when another lock is posted for the same keys or when a sibling starts or stops reporting. GET /lock/configHash/{configHash} does not use this rule: it returns the most recently created lock, which can be is_current false.

superseded_by.description: lock_hash of the current lock that shares validator keys or the config_hash with this one, when this lock is not current; null when it is current.

cluster_definition.description: Cluster definition data that was used in dkg to generate cluster lock.

validator_count.description: Number of distributed validators in this cluster lock.

definition_stored.description: true: cluster_definition is the exact definition this lock was created with (covered by lock_hash). false: this lock was stored without its exact cluster definition; lock_hash cannot be re-verified until the lock file is posted again.

is_current.description: true: this is the current lock for its validators and config_hash. Several locks can share validator keys or a config_hash (re-split or DKG re-run); the current one is the lock whose Charon nodes reported most recently to Obol monitoring, or, when none of them has reported, the most recently created. It can change when another lock is posted for the same keys or when a sibling starts or stops reporting. GET /lock/configHash/{configHash} does not use this rule: it returns the most recently created lock, which can be is_current false.

superseded_by.description: lock_hash of the current lock that shares validator keys or the config_hash with this one, when this lock is not current; null when it is current.

distributed_validators.description: distributed validator keys and deposit data.

index.description: Validator index. Null while the validator is only in the pending deposit queue (status pending_deposit).

status.description: Beacon API validator status (pending_initialized, pending_queued, active_ongoing, active_exiting, active_slashed, exited_unslashed, exited_slashed, withdrawal_possible, withdrawal_done), or pending_deposit when the pubkey is not yet in the validator registry but has a deposit in the pending deposit queue (EIP-6110). Pubkeys in neither are omitted from the response.

balance.description: Balance in ETH. Null for status pending_deposit.

effective_balance.description: Effective balance in ETH. Null for status pending_deposit.

withdrawal_credentials.description: Withdrawal credentials. For status pending_deposit, those of the first queued deposit with a valid signature, which the validator will be created with (the beacon chain drops queued deposits with an invalid signature for a pubkey not yet in the registry). Null for status pending_deposit when no queued deposit has a valid signature, or while the signatures up to the first valid one are not checked yet (checked in the background, usually within a slot; retry).

pending_partial_withdrawals.description: Queued partial withdrawals in ETH. Null for status pending_deposit or when the queue is unavailable.

pending_partial_deposits.description: Sum of queued deposits for this pubkey in ETH (top-ups, or for status pending_deposit the initial deposit). If the queue cannot be read the request fails with 502.

is_not_within_committee.description: Indicates if validator has been active for at least 256 epochs and is not within the committee period. Null when unknown, including for status pending_deposit.

credentials_conflict.description: True when the pubkey is only in the pending deposit queue (status pending_deposit) and its queued deposits with valid signatures carry different withdrawal credentials: someone able to sign for the key signed a deposit for other credentials. Only the first valid one applies. Always false for a validator already in the registry. Null while the API has not yet checked every queued deposit signature for the pubkey (checked in the background, usually within a slot).

operator_exits.description: An object where the key is an operator address and the value is a number of signed validators.

isTermsAndConditionsSigned.description: Boolean Value Indicating if Terms and Conditions Have Been Signed

merkle_proof.description: The Merkle proof (an array of hashes) generated for the recipient

enr.description: ENR text for the Charon node whose private key signed the payload

sig.description: Base64-encoded secp256k1 ECDSA signature (65 bytes: 32-byte r + 32-byte s + 1-byte recovery id) over the SSZ `hashTreeRoot` of the UTF-8 bytes of `JSON.stringify(data)`, matching Charon `publishResultToObolAPI`

pubkeys.description: Optional list of validator pubkeys to filter by. If omitted or empty, returns all validators with registrations.

total_balance_usd.description: Total balance in USD across all clusters at the specified timestamp (calculated using ETH closing price for that day, rounded to nearest integer)

balance_eth.description: Balance in ETH at the snapshot timestamp

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the data snapshot. All data in this response (balances, counts) is for this specific timestamp.

balances.description: Array of validator balances at the snapshot timestamp

total_count.description: Total number of validators at the snapshot timestamp (used for pagination)

total_pages.description: Total number of pages based on the limit parameter and total_count at the snapshot timestamp

additionalAddresses.description: Additional addresses to search (e.g. split addresses from getRelatedSplits, DeFi wrapper WA)

withdrawal_resolved.description: V2: resolved recipients for non-EOA withdrawal addresses

fee_recipient_resolved.description: V2: resolved recipients for non-EOA fee recipients

total_balance_eth.description: Sum of balance_eth for matched validators (latest snapshot). Null when no recent snapshot is available.

avg_effectiveness.description: Average effectiveness for matched validators (latest snapshot). Null when no recent snapshot is available.

cluster_apr.description: Average APR of affiliated validators (from validator_apy in clusterinformationdetailedv3). Null when no recent snapshot is available.

pubkeys.description: Validator BLS pubkeys (96 hex chars, 0x prefix optional). Max 1000 per request.

signatureValid.description: Whether the deposit's BLS signature (DepositMessage in the deposit domain, the network's genesis fork version) is valid. For a pubkey not yet in the registry, the beacon chain drops queued deposits with an invalid signature until the first valid one creates the validator. Null when not checked: the pubkey is already in the registry, so the deposit is a top-up and its signature does not matter; or the background check has not reached it yet (signaturesPending).

status.description: new: not in the validator registry and nothing queued. queued: only in the pending deposit queue, or registry status pending_initialized / pending_queued. active: registry status active_*. exited: registry status exited_* or withdrawal_*.

beaconStatus.description: Raw beacon API status (pending_initialized, pending_queued, active_ongoing, active_exiting, active_slashed, exited_unslashed, exited_slashed, withdrawal_possible, withdrawal_done), or pending_deposit when the pubkey is only in the pending deposit queue (EIP-6110). Null for status new.

index.description: Validator index. Null unless the pubkey is in the registry.

balance.description: Balance in wei (decimal string). Null unless the pubkey is in the registry.

effectiveBalance.description: Effective balance in wei (decimal string). Null unless the pubkey is in the registry.

activationEpoch.description: Epoch at which the validator was (or will be) activated, as a decimal string. Null unless the pubkey is in the registry, and while no activation epoch is assigned yet (FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH, e.g. pending_initialized).

exitEpoch.description: Epoch at which the validator exits (or exited), as a decimal string. Null unless the pubkey is in the registry, and while no exit is initiated (FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH).

pendingPartialWithdrawals.description: Sum of the validator's entries in the beacon chain's pending partial withdrawal queue (EIP-7002), in wei (decimal string). "0" when none, and for a pubkey not in the registry.

withdrawalCredentials.description: The registry entry's withdrawal credentials; for a pubkey only in the queue, those of its first queued deposit with a valid signature (the validator is created with them; queued deposits with an invalid signature are dropped). Null for status new, for a queue-only pubkey with no validly signed queued deposit, and while the deposits up to the first valid one are not verified yet (signaturesPending).

credentialsConflict.description: True when the pubkey is only in the queue and its queued deposits with valid signatures carry different withdrawal credentials: someone able to sign for the key signed a deposit for other credentials. Only the first valid one applies. Always false for a pubkey in the registry (its credentials are fixed) or with nothing queued. Null while signaturesPending.

signaturesPending.description: True when the pubkey is only in the queue and some of its queued deposit signatures have not been verified yet. Signatures are verified in the background, each queue entry once, usually within a slot; until then those deposits have signatureValid null, credentialsConflict is null, and withdrawalCredentials is null unless already decided by a verified first valid deposit. Retry for the complete answer. Always false for registered and new pubkeys.

pendingDeposits.description: Every deposit queued for this pubkey (initial deposits and top-ups), in queue order, each with its own withdrawal credentials and signature check. Empty when nothing is queued.

validators.description: One entry per distinct requested pubkey (case-insensitive), in request order.

status.description: `obol` iff the network OVM factory emitted CreateObolValidatorManager for this address; `notObol` if it did not (or the address has no contract code); `unknown` if it could not be checked.

factoryAddress.description: The OVM factory of this network

creationTxHash.description: Transaction that created the OVM (status `obol` only)

creationBlock.description: Block the OVM was created in (status `obol` only)

roles.description: `rolesOf(address)` at `blockNumber` (bit mask), as a decimal string: the owner can set any of the 256 bits, beyond what a JSON number holds exactly

roleNames.description: Names of the set bits: WITHDRAWAL 0x01, CONSOLIDATION 0x02, SET_BENEFICIARY 0x04, RECOVER_FUNDS 0x08, SET_REWARD 0x10, DEPOSIT 0x20

isOwner.description: Whether this holder is the owner (always the first entry)

publicForwarder.description: True when the holder is a public call forwarder (Multicall3 0xcA11bde05977b3631167028862bE2a173976CA11, or, where they have code, Multicall2 0x5BA1e12693Dc8F9c48aAD8770482f4739bEeD696 and Multicall 0xeefBa1e63905eF1D7ACbA5a8513c70307C1cE441): anyone can call role-gated functions through it, so the role is effectively public.

grantedAtBlock.description: Block of the most recent RolesUpdated log for this holder at or before `blockNumber` (each log sets the full role mask, so this is when its current roles were set). null when no RolesUpdated log names the holder (an owner without roles).

grantedAtTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of `grantedAtBlock`; null when `grantedAtBlock` is null or the block header could not be read.

kind.description: Which OVM recipient this split is

splitHash.description: `splitHash()` at `blockNumber`; the params hash to it

source.description: The log the params were read from

status.description: `new` (in a lock for this OVM, no deposit seen), `queued` (in the pending deposit queue or pending activation), `active`, `exited` (exited or withdrawable/withdrawn)

beaconStatus.description: Beacon API status; `pending_deposit` when only in the deposit queue; null for `new`

withdrawalCredentials.description: Registry credentials; for a queued validator the credentials it will be created with; for `new` the credentials in its lock

lockHash.description: Lock hash, when the validator is in a lock whose withdrawal address is this OVM

clusterName.description: Name in that lock's cluster definition; null when `lockHash` is null or the definition has no name

blockNumber.description: Block every chain read (state, roles, splits) was made at

amountOfPrincipalStake.description: wei. A routing counter raised by OVM.deposit, not a measure of stake: compare with `principalOnBeaconChain`.

version.description: `version()`, null if the contract has none

roles.description: Owner first (with its roles, possibly 0), then every other RolesUpdated candidate with roles at `blockNumber`. null if the role events or rolesOf could not be read, and for an address whose provenance is not `obol`.

splits.description: The recipients that are 0xSplits v2 PullSplits, with params whose hash equals their `splitHash()`. null if they could not be checked, and for an address whose provenance is not `obol`.

validators.description: Validators whose credentials (or queued deposit credentials) point at this OVM, plus undeposited validators of locks for it. null if the beacon node could not be read, and for an address whose provenance is not `obol`.

principalOnBeaconChain.description: wei. The principal this OVM is responsible for: the sum of processed beacon-chain deposits credited to validators whose withdrawal credentials point at this OVM (by the validator's current credentials), adjusted for consolidations into/out of those validators, minus principal already paid out by the OVM (sum of DistributeFunds.principalPayout). null until processed deposits are indexed (see `notes`).

example: principalOnBeaconChain is null: processed deposits are not indexed
notes.description: Anything partial or unavailable in this answer

message.description: What went wrong; a list for request validation errors. Always "Internal server error" for a 500.

error.description: HTTP reason phrase, on most 4xx responses.
